# When --use-receiver-type names a type that does not define a called method,
# generate notes the inferred signature so the untyped fallback is visible
# where it originates instead of surfacing later as check errors on any. The
# explanation prints once after the list, not per method.

muxt generate --use-receiver-type=T
cmp stdout want-out.txt

exec go vet .

-- want-out.txt --
note: T does not define ListPages(ctx context.Context) any
note: T does not define About(ctx context.Context) any
note: the inferred signatures return any — implement the methods to type-check the templates against real types
wrote template_routes.go: 2 routes
-- template.gohtml --
{{- define "GET / ListPages(ctx)" -}}ok{{- end -}}
{{- define "GET /about About(ctx)" -}}hi{{- end -}}
-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.24
-- template.go --
package server

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*"))

type T struct{}
